user_query: trass stories and trass gmail with the term mgm within the last 3 months. For trass stories, also include terms UK, CA, AU and timeline

intent.goal: Search for MGM-related content in Trass Stories and Trass Gmail, with additional geography and timeline terms for Stories only

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
    u.page_id,
    u.workspace,
    u.database_name,
    u.title,
    u.created_time,
    COALESCE(g.subject, '') as subject,
    COALESCE(g.sender_name, '') as sender_name,
    COALESCE(g.sender_email, '') as sender_email,
    COALESCE(g.message_content, '') as message_content
FROM unified_content u
LEFT JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id AND u.database_name = 'gmail'
WHERE u.workspace = 'trass'
AND u.database_name IN ('stories', 'gmail')
AND u.created_time >= datetime('now', '-3 months')
AND (
    (u.database_name = 'gmail' AND (
        g.subject LIKE '%MGM%' OR 
        g.message_content LIKE '%MGM%'
    ))
    OR
    (u.database_name = 'stories' AND (
        u.title LIKE '%MGM%' OR 
        (
            u.title LIKE '%geography%' OR 
            u.title LIKE '%timeline%' OR
            u.title LIKE '%location%' OR
            u.title LIKE '%time%'
        )
    ))
)
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 1200
